# Support

regency has one maintainer and no support hours. Everything happens in public and is read weekly, best
effort. There is no private or paid support.

| You have | Go to |
|---|---|
| a question, an install problem, an idea to talk through | [Discussions](https://github.com/Trevojan/regency/discussions) |
| a defect you can reproduce | [New issue → Defect](https://github.com/Trevojan/regency/issues/new/choose) |
| a security problem | [Report a vulnerability](https://github.com/Trevojan/regency/security/advisories/new), never in public |

Before asking, run `python scripts/doctor.py` in the regency folder and read `README.md` → Installation.
